title: Redis: per-node health probes
description: Runs `nexus health redis` -- SSH'd INFO replication probe per node + threshold-driven status. Replicas with > 5s lag yellow, > 30s lag red.

observe.what: probes table: 6 'role' rows (one per node) + 3 'replication-lag' rows (one per replica) with seconds + threshold; overall health summary

whatProves: Per-node INFO replication parsing works; replication-lag threshold classification (green <5s / yellow <30s / red >=30s) renders correctly.
